# Godot XR Tools Tac Gloves

These low-poly tactical glove models and textures are
derived from the Godot XR Tools `hands` assets:

https://github.com/GodotVR/godot-xr-tools/tree/master/addons/godot-xr-tools/hands

The included `LICENSE.md` is the upstream CC0 1.0 license. CrimsonVR uses the
Glove Caucasian Green Camo and Glove African Dark Camo materials only. Godot's
`XRHandModifier3D` supplies the runtime pose; scene wiring is local to CrimsonVR.
